title: Lightdash MCP server
description: Declares Lightdash's remote MCP server in base's MCP files for Claude Code, Codex and oh-my-pi, at LIGHTDASH_URL/api/v1/mcp: Claude Code and oh-my-pi expand LIGHTDASH_URL from mise's environment, falling back to the scaffolded instance, and Codex, which expands no variables in a URL, takes the instance as written. Definition only, authorised per person with OAuth.

lines: # Codex does not expand variables in a URL, so this one repeats LIGHTDASH_URL from mise.toml.
